executive_summary.text: On 2026-11-18 between 10:15:00-10:27:10 UTC, account j.mehta on host fin-app-02 (IP 10.20.5.18) experienced 30 SSH authentication failures from external IP 203.0.113.77, followed by a successful login at 10:25:03Z from the same IP, and a privileged sudo command at 10:27:10Z executing /usr/bin/cat /etc/shadow as ROOT. Source IP 203.0.113.77 has MOCK intel reputation score 92 (malicious: ssh-bruteforce, password-spraying, scanner). Severity: high; confidence: medium. Unknowns: host criticality (not in asset inventory), full network session details, and whether the sudo command exfiltrated data or was reconnaissance.
